title: [finding] The v18 direction-B tracker "#6590" is a 404, but two `component.zod.ts` sites still point decisions at it — and the #9249 landing note it was owed cannot be delivered
body:
Found at #9249's landing window (spec seat, `session_01RadETjNRLALFLhFA3xehZP`, 2026-08-23). Filed unassigned for triage; recording, not claiming.

## Measured

- `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/6590` → **404** (a closed issue returns 200, so the card was deleted, transferred, or converted — this session cannot distinguish which; semantic issue-search was returning zero for positive controls at measurement time, so search evidence is void).
- Two source sites on `origin/main` (`8da636880`) still anchor a live decision to it:
  - `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:137` — "v18 as #6590 — not rejected."
  - `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:1894` — "tracked as #6590 for v18" (the direction-B question: retire the flat `object`/`filter` data-binding family and make `dataSource` the single data-binding door).
- The triage ruling on #9249 assigned its PM a landing-time step: "leave the subsumption note on hold #6590". That note cannot be delivered to a 404.

## Why it matters

The direction-B v18 decision now has **no resolvable tracking card** while the source text tells the next author one exists. Additionally, its factual premise has moved: PR #11244 (#9249) retired `element:form` whole, and #9220 had already retired `element:filter` — so **both named element carriers of the flat family are gone**, and what remains of the direction-B question is only the `ElementDataSourceSchema`-side flat keys (whose docblock PR #11244 already updated to record the carrier status). The subsumption content that was owed to #6590 is preserved here and in that docblock.

## Suggested disposition (triage's call)

Either (a) locate where #6590 went (transfer target / discussion) and confirm the two source refs still resolve for a human, or (b) mint a new v18 direction-B card with the current premise (both element carriers retired; remaining scope = the `ElementDataSourceSchema` flat keys) and fix the two `component.zod.ts` refs in a mechanical follow-up. A dangling tracking ref in contract source is the same class as a dead evidence pointer (#11210) — it survives review because it looks precise.

Back-links: #9249 · PR #11244 · #9220 · #11210 (the dead-pointer sibling class).
